about: What a filing rule falls back to where the place's row in data/research/elections/filing-requirements.json carries none (Alaska, Connecticut, Rhode Island, D.C. and the territories for counties; Hawaii and two territories for municipalities; Vermont's legislature). Each is an estimate (SG-GOV-filing-fallbacks): the median of the read values for that office family over the 56 places.

countyOffice.estimatedFrom: Median of the 47 read county minimum ages (all 18) in filing-requirements.json

municipalOffice.estimatedFrom: Median of the 53 read municipal minimum ages in filing-requirements.json

stateLegislative.estimatedFrom: Median of the 55 read state-legislative minimum ages in filing-requirements.json

statewideExecutive.estimatedFrom: Median of the read statewide-executive minimum ages in filing-requirements.json

usHouse.citation: U.S. Const. art. I, sec. 2, cl. 2

registeredVoterRequired.estimatedFrom: A candidate who is a voter is the common rule; unread rows assume it
